$description: Mobile scope tokens (added by ds init when the mobile scope is enabled). Web CSS and the native scaffold (ds mobile scaffold) read the same values, so a sheet peeks and a swipe action reveals at the same size on every platform. Colors come from existing roles (feedback.*, action.*, bg.surface); this scope adds no colors.

peek.$description: Visible height of a detent-sheet at its lowest snap: handle plus one line of content.

swipe-action.$description: Width of each revealed swipe-actions button (at least 44 px tall by row height).
